main.ai_text: During this study and preparation of the manuscript, the authors used ChatGPT Sol 5.6 to assist with source-code inspection, code debugging, numerical consistency checks, analysis of computational outputs, and revision of the manuscript and supplementary material, and to assist with initial drafting and language revision. The authors directed these activities and repeatedly reviewed the AI-assisted work against the study's methods, computational records, and research objectives, checking implementation correctness and completeness and evaluating interpretations against the available evidence. The authors determined which suggestions to adopt, revise, or reject, made the final methodological and interpretive decisions, and take full responsibility for the manuscript and supplementary material.
main.title: Recalibration Can Mask Measured Sensitivity to Receiver-Coordinate Errors in RSSI Localization
